context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 103 tested the Employee Permissions Architecture change from flat {module: {view, action}} to separated {modules: {module: boolean}, panels: {panelId: {canView, canCreate, canEdit}}}. All backend APIs work correctly with dev-test-token authentication. Key features verified: (1) /modules endpoint returns both system modules and custom panels arrays, (2) Role templates use new format with modules and panels keys, (3) my-access returns normalized permissions and permittedPanels array, (4) list endpoint normalizes old format permissions, (5) link and update endpoints accept new format, (6) normalize_permissions() handles backward compatibility, (7) Panel access enforcement uses check_panel_access with granular permissions. Frontend code review confirmed PermissionGrid has separate System Modules and Custom Panels sections with granular controls. Existing panels in DB: 'QC Panel' (green) and 'Dispatch Tracker' (orange).
